issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Screen Studio 4.0
products.tagline: Glass Loupe, Camera Cutout, Edit by Transcript, and more
products.summaryZh: 玻璃放大镜、相机镂空、按转录编辑等
products.descriptionZh: 适用于 Mac 的屏幕录制器，能处理缩放、动态、声音和构图等棘手环节。每个演示和教程都能呈现得精致专业。4.0 版新功能：- Glass Loupe，可放大某一细节的缩放功能 - 分屏，也适用于竖屏视频 - 像编辑文本一样编辑视频 - 摄像头抠像：只保留你，去除背景 - 自动隐藏敏感数据和面部 - 更清晰的缩放、ProRes、导出速度最高提升 4 倍，以及更多
products.description: The screen recorder for Mac that handles the hard parts: zooms, motion, sound, and framing. Every demo and tutorial comes out polished. What's new in 4.0: - Glass Loupe, a zoom that magnifies one detail - Split screen, also for vertical video - Edit your video like you edit text - Camera cutout: you, without your background - Hide sensitive data and faces automatically - Sharper zooms, ProRes, up to 4x faster exports, and more

products.name: ClawsGO Science
products.tagline: The AI research agent with its own cloud lab
products.summaryZh: 拥有自己云实验室的AI研究代理
products.descriptionZh: 研究，完全自动化。ClawsGO Science 将一个问题推进至发现，并撰写成一篇带引用的论文。其云实验室拥有 500 多种工具和 90 多个数据集。其长时程执行框架可让 Claude 和 GPT 智能体集群连续运行数天。科学的下一个范式。
products.description: Research, fully automated. ClawsGO Science takes a question to discovery and writes it up as a cited paper. Its cloud lab has 500+ tools and 90+ datasets. Its long-horizon harness runs clusters of Claude and GPT agents for days. The next paradigm for science.

products.name: Riverside Agents
products.tagline: A team of AI agents for video: produce, edit, clip, post
products.summaryZh: 一支视频AI智能体团队：制作、编辑、剪辑、发布
products.descriptionZh: Riverside Agents 是一支专为视频打造的 AI 智能体团队。Producer 为你的录制做准备，Editor 将原始录制素材制作成完整单集，Clipper 剪辑出精彩片段用于社交短视频，Marketer 撰写字幕并安排发布。自动化程度由你决定，未经你批准不会发布任何内容。所有 Riverside 方案均包含此功能，并提供 14 天免费试用。
products.description: Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial.

products.name: Embage
products.tagline: Build agent for your customers, run workflows, analyzed.
products.summaryZh: 为你的客户构建代理，运行工作流，进行分析。
products.descriptionZh: 为你的网站、Telegram 及其他渠道构建多渠道 AI 聊天与语音代理。创建专门的子代理，实时编排跨知识库、数据存储和数百种第三方工具的工作流。自动评估每次交互，为线索质量评分，并直接从对话记录中提取结构化数据。
products.description: Build multichannel AI chat and voice agents for your website, Telegram, and beyond. Create specialized sub-agents to orchestrate workflows across your knowledge bases, datastores, and hundreds of third-party tools in real time. Automatically evaluate every interaction, score lead quality, and extract structured data straight from conversation transcripts.

products.name: Precise Edit by Ideogram
products.tagline: Precise editing with context window
products.summaryZh: 具有上下文窗口的精确编辑
products.descriptionZh: 升级后的 Precise Edit 支持上下文窗口，因此能以原始像素编辑分辨率最高达 8K 的图像，并更清晰地呈现小号文字、徽标和精细细节。
products.description: The upgraded Precise Edit supports a context window, so it edits images at any resolution up to 8K at their original pixels and renders small text, logos, and fine detail more sharply.

products.name: agentmash
products.tagline: open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents
products.summaryZh: 面向团队编码代理的开源多玩家 AI
products.descriptionZh: Agentmash 是面向团队编码代理的开源多人 AI，是一个共享上下文层，它会告知每个代理队友的代理正在修改哪些文件，使代理之间能够相互沟通并自主工作，而不会覆盖任何人的代码。你可以在运行于不同模型的任务之间切换，像在 Slack 中一样 @ 提及队友、自己的代理或队友的代理，并让技能、聊天和自动化保持同步。可连接 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 或你自己的开源模型
products.description: Agentmash is an open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents, a shared context layer that tells every agent which files a teammate's agent is changing, so the agents talk to each other and work on their own without overwriting anyone's code. You can switch between tasks running on different models, @mention a teammate, your own agent or a teammate's agent like in Slack, and keep skills, chats and automations in sync. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or your own open-source models

products.name: Click
products.tagline: Managed agents API that works with any model
products.summaryZh: 可与任何模型配合使用的托管代理 API
products.descriptionZh: Managed Agents API，可与任何模型配合使用。通过一次 API 调用发送任务，Click 便会运行智能体并流式返回结果。Click 通过 API 为你提供完整的智能体技术栈，无需管理任何基础设施。创建会话时，智能体所需的一切均已就绪——沙箱、浏览器和网页搜索。智能体运行在集成了最新创新的 harness 上，例如支持数千种工具的工具延迟发现，以及通过脚本使用工具的 Code Mode。
products.description: Managed Agents API you can use with any model. Send a task with an API call, and Click runs the agent and streams back results. Click gives you the entire agent stack over an API, with no infrastructure to manage. Sessions are created with everything your agent needs - a sandbox, browser, and web search. Agents run on a harness with the latest innovations, like deferred tool discovery to support 1000s of tools, and Code Mode to use tools with scripts.

products.name: Modelpeers
products.tagline: Follow AI models and agents like you follow people
products.summaryZh: 像关注人一样关注AI模型和智能体
products.descriptionZh: Modelpeers 就像是 AI 模型和智能体的 LinkedIn。关注 Claude Code、GPT-6、Gemini 以及其他 200 多个模型，在你的信息流中查看它们的新版本、价格与限制变化、服务中断和退役情况。
products.description: Modelpeers is like LinkedIn for AI models and agents. Follow Claude Code, GPT-6, Gemini and 200 others, and see their new versions, price and limit changes, outages and retirements in your feed.

products.name: magpie
products.tagline: everything you’ve saved, in one visual library
products.summaryZh: 你保存的一切，尽在一个视觉资料库中
products.descriptionZh: 一个视觉库，收纳你在 Instagram、X、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube、Reddit、Dribbble、Behance、Are.na 和网页上保存的一切。由 AI 打标签，可按含义和颜色搜索，即使原帖已删除也能保留。
products.description: One visual library for everything you save on Instagram, X, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Reddit, Dribbble, Behance, Are.na and the web. Tagged by AI, searchable by meaning and colour, and kept even when the post is gone.

products.name: Raah.dev
products.tagline: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance
products.summaryZh: 跟踪你的收入、分析和网站表现
products.descriptionZh: 将支付和转化与页面速度、API 延迟、错误及 ISP 性能连接在同一个仪表板中。面向人类和 AI 智能体的收入分析与真实用户可观测性。
products.description: Connect payments and conversions with page speed, API latency, errors, and ISP performance in one dashboard. Revenue analytics and real-user observability for humans and AI agents.

products.name: BeeBranch
products.tagline: The local-first desktop Git client
products.summaryZh: 本地优先的桌面 Git 客户端
products.descriptionZh: 一个面向使用 GitLab 和 GitHub 的团队的开源替代方案，可替代商业 Git 客户端：无专有云、无供应商账户、无遥测、无 AI。
products.description: An open-source alternative to commercial Git clients, built for teams working with GitLab and GitHub: no proprietary cloud, no vendor account, no telemetry and no AI.

products.name: Yuzu Sync
products.tagline: Mirror, copy or two-way sync folders on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上镜像、拷贝或双向同步文件夹
products.descriptionZh: 一款小巧的菜单栏应用，内置 rsync 引擎，让成对的文件夹保持同步。可将项目镜像到 SSD、将照片复制到 NAS，或双向同步。先预览变更，安排定时任务；记住的磁盘按 UUID 匹配，因此同名但错误的磁盘会被拒绝。它替换或删除的每个文件都会归档 30 天，绝不静默删除。支持 macOS 14 及以上。
products.description: A small menu-bar app that keeps pairs of folders in sync with a bundled rsync engine. Mirror a project to an SSD, copy photos to a NAS, or sync both ways. Preview changes first, schedule jobs, and remembered disks are matched by UUID so a same-named wrong disk is refused. Every file it replaces or removes is archived for 30 days, never silently deleted. macOS 14+.

products.name: ernd
products.tagline: The credit card for the AI stack
products.summaryZh: 为AI技术栈打造的信用卡
products.descriptionZh: ernd 是一款面向为 AI 付费的公司的信用卡。在 AI 供应商处刷卡消费可获 4% 返现，我们正与 AI 提供商洽谈大型合作，以争取更优价格、更快推理和专用 GPU。
products.description: ernd is a credit card for companies that pay for AI. Card spend at AI vendors earns 4% back, and we're negotiating big partnerships with AI providers for better pricing, faster inference and dedicated GPUs.

products.name: Termy
products.tagline: Your coding agent, in the notch
products.summaryZh: 你的编程助手，就在刘海屏里
products.descriptionZh: Claude Code 和 Codex 在从 MacBook 刘海处下拉的终端中运行。实时状态、从刘海处审批、你的智能体办公室、本地服务器浏览器、设备端听写和检查点。
products.description: Claude Code and Codex in a terminal that drops down from your MacBook's notch. Live status, approvals from the notch, an office of your agents, a browser for your local server, on-device dictation and checkpoints.

products.name: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0
products.tagline: Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch
products.summaryZh: 在你的 Mac、iPhone、iPad 和 Watch 上查看 Claude + ChatGPT 的使用限额
products.descriptionZh: 版本 4 是一次大更新。Claude 的用量统计现在也覆盖 ChatGPT 账户，Codex 会话和周限额与 Claude 并列显示。可在三种样式（极简、详细、图表）中一次查看所有账户，将多个账户放入 Mac 菜单栏，并在 iPhone、iPad、Apple Watch 和小组件上保持同步。提醒会在额度耗尽前通知你，历史记录则展示你这一周的用量去向。你需在 Claude 和 ChatGPT 官方页面登录，数据保留在你自己的 iCloud 中。免费使用，Pro 提供额外功能。
products.description: Version 4 is a big one. Usage for Claude now tracks ChatGPT accounts too, with your Codex session and weekly limits next to Claude's. See every account at once in three styles (Minimal, Detailed, Chart), put several in the Mac menu bar, and keep them on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and widgets. Alerts tell you before you run out, and the history shows where your week went. You sign in on the official Claude and ChatGPT pages, and your data stays in your own iCloud. Free, with Pro extras.

products.name: Hamdori
products.tagline: A tiny 3D hamster that lives on your desktop
products.summaryZh: 一只住在你桌面上的迷你3D仓鼠
products.descriptionZh: 一只住在你 Mac 或 Windows 桌面角落的 3D 金丝熊。你抚摸他时他会闭上眼睛，你打字时他会啃种子，你离开时他会打盹。还有专注计时器、玩具和文件抽屉。无需监控权限，一次性购买。
products.description: A 3D golden hamster who lives in a corner of your Mac or Windows desktop. He closes his eyes when you pet him, nibbles seeds while you type and naps when you walk away. Focus timer, toys and a file drawer too. No monitoring permissions, one-time purchase.

products.name: Fluent 2
products.tagline: AI teammates that run locally on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在你的 Mac 上本地运行的 AI 队友
products.descriptionZh: 隆重推出 AI 队友——为你的日常工作节省数小时。它们像你一样使用你的应用，并在你睡觉时继续工作。在本地模型上运行它们：完全私密、无使用限制，每月 0 美元。或者选择你喜欢的任何云端模型。
products.description: Introducing AI teammates – saving hours on your routine. They use your apps like you do and keep working while you sleep. Run them on a local model: fully private, no usage limits, and $0 a month. Or pick any cloud model you like.

products.name: AI Manga Translator
products.tagline: Translate full manga pages with text back in the bubbles
products.summaryZh: 将整页漫画连同气泡中的文字一起翻译回气泡内。
products.descriptionZh: 上传一页日本漫画、韩国条漫或中国漫画，即可获得一张已将对话放回页面上的翻译图片，无需逐个复制对话框。可翻译单页、排队最多20页、转换CBZ或ZIP章节，或在正在阅读的页面上使用Chrome扩展程序。1积分对应1页，失败页面会退还积分，一次性购买的积分包永不过期。
products.description: Upload a Japanese manga, Korean manhwa or Chinese comic page and get a translated image with the dialogue placed back on the page, instead of copying bubbles one by one. Translate a single page, queue up to 20 pages, convert a CBZ or ZIP chapter, or use the Chrome extension on the page you're reading. 1 credit is 1 page, failed pages are refunded, and one-time packs never expire.

products.name: CutCat
products.tagline: Skip or mute marked scenes while you watch Netflix
products.summaryZh: 观看Netflix时跳过或静音标记的场景
products.descriptionZh: 一款免费的Chrome扩展程序，可跳过或静音其他观众标记为性、裸露、血腥或粗俗语言的场景。你可以自行选择。适用于电脑上Chrome浏览器中的Netflix。与Netflix无关联。
products.description: A free Chrome extension that skips or mutes scenes other viewers have marked as sex, nudity, gore, or strong language. You choose which. Works on Netflix in Chrome on a computer. Not affiliated with Netflix.

products.name: Chorin: Ora et Labora
products.tagline: Build a real medieval abbey, from 1258 to today
products.summaryZh: 建造一座真正的1258年至今的中世纪修道院
products.descriptionZh: 一款关于柏林附近真实存在的西多会修道院克洛斯特·科林（Kloster Chorin）的平静放置游戏。每位修士都有名字；季节与夜晚会改变工作内容，每一页编年史都注明其来源。免费开始，无广告，支持八种语言，可离线游玩。
products.description: A calm idle game about Kloster Chorin, a real Cistercian abbey near Berlin. Every monk has a name; the seasons and the night change the work, and every chronicle page cites its sources. Free to start, no ads, eight languages, works offline.
